groups.A: Any doctor or dentist can give you a prescription for it.
groups.B: Your doctor has to get approval from the Barbados Drug Service before you can have it.

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.summary: Metformin is a tablet that helps control the sugar in your blood if you have type 2 diabetes.
medicines.treats: It helps your body use its own insulin better, so less sugar stays in your blood.
medicines.looks: They are tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 500 mg and 850 mg.
medicines.safe: Not always. If your kidneys or liver are not well, your doctor may give you less or choose a different medication.

medicines.name: Gliclazide
medicines.summary: Gliclazide is a tablet that lowers the sugar in your blood if you have type 2 diabetes.
medicines.treats: It helps your body make more insulin, which brings your blood sugar down.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in one size: 80 mg.
medicines.safe: Not always. It can make your blood sugar go too low, so you may feel shaky, sweaty or confused. Eat or drink something sugary and tell your doctor if this happens.

medicines.name: Amlodipine
medicines.summary: Amlodipine is a tablet that lowers your blood pressure.
medicines.treats: It relaxes your blood vessels so blood flows through them more easily.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 5 mg and 10 mg.
medicines.safe: Most people can take it. Your ankles may swell at first. Tell your doctor if it does not go away.

medicines.name: Lisinopril
medicines.summary: Lisinopril is a tablet that lowers your blood pressure and protects your heart and kidneys.
medicines.treats: Doctors also use it after a heart attack and for some kidney problems.
medicines.looks: They are tablets. They come in 3 sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg and 20 mg.
medicines.safe: Not always. Do not take it if you are pregnant or trying to get pregnant. Tell your doctor if you get a dry cough that will not go away.
medicines.treatsHeading: What else is it used for?

medicines.name: Hydrochlorothiazide
medicines.summary: Hydrochlorothiazide is a water tablet that lowers your blood pressure.
medicines.treats: It makes your body get rid of extra water and salt when you pee.
medicines.looks: They are small white tablets. They come in one size: 25 mg.
medicines.safe: Most people can take it. Your doctor may check your blood now and then, because it can change the salt levels in your body.

medicines.name: Natrixam
medicines.summary: Natrixam is one tablet with 2 blood pressure medications in it. It lowers your blood pressure.
medicines.treats: Indapamide is a water tablet. Amlodipine relaxes your blood vessels. Your doctor may give you this if you already take both, so you have 1 tablet instead of 2.
medicines.looks: They are tablets. They come in 2 strengths: 1.5 mg indapamide with 5 mg amlodipine, and 1.5 mg indapamide with 10 mg amlodipine.
medicines.safe: Not always. Do not take it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you have serious kidney or liver problems. Your doctor may check your blood, because it can lower the potassium in your body.

medicines.name: Salbutamol inhaler
medicines.summary: A salbutamol inhaler quickly opens up your airways when you are wheezy or short of breath.
medicines.treats: It is a reliever: you use it when you need it, not every day.
medicines.looks: It is a blue inhaler, sometimes called a pump.
safe: Most people can use it.
Your hands may shake or your heart may beat faster for a short time.
If you need it more than 3 times a week, tell your doctor.
If your inhaler is not helping and you still cannot breathe, call 511.
medicines.treatsHeading: What kind of inhaler is it?

medicines.name: Beclometasone inhaler
medicines.summary: A beclometasone inhaler helps stop asthma attacks from starting.
medicines.treats: It is a preventer: you use it every day, even when you feel well.
medicines.safe: Most people can use it. It can give you a sore mouth or throat. Rinsing your mouth after each use helps stop this.
medicines.treatsHeading: What kind of inhaler is it?

medicines.name: Carbamazepine
medicines.summary: Carbamazepine is a tablet that helps stop seizures (fits) if you have epilepsy.
medicines.treats: Doctors also use it for some kinds of nerve pain.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 200 mg and 400 mg.
medicines.safe: Not always. It can affect other medications, including the contraceptive pill. Tell your doctor about everything you take. Do not stop taking it suddenly. Talk to your doctor first.
medicines.treatsHeading: What else is it used for?

medicines.name: Timolol eye drops
medicines.summary: Timolol eye drops lower the pressure inside your eye if you have glaucoma.
medicines.treats: Glaucoma is when pressure builds up in your eye and can damage your sight.
medicines.looks: It is a small bottle of eye drops.
medicines.safe: Not always. Tell your doctor if you have asthma or a slow heartbeat. The drops can affect your breathing and heart.

medicines.name: Tamoxifen
medicines.summary: Tamoxifen is a tablet that helps stop some breast cancers from growing or coming back.
medicines.treats: It blocks a hormone that some breast cancers need to grow.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in one size: 20 mg.
medicines.safe: Not always. Do not take it if you are pregnant. Call 511 straight away if one leg becomes painful and swollen, or if you are suddenly short of breath.

medicines.name: Amoxicillin
medicines.summary: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic that treats infections caused by bacteria.
medicines.treats: Chest, ear and throat infections. It does not work on colds or flu.
medicines.looks: They are capsules. They come in 2 sizes: 250 mg and 500 mg. There is also a liquid for children.
medicines.safe: Not always. Do not take it if you are allergic to penicillin. Tell the pharmacist if you have ever had a rash from an antibiotic.

medicines.name: Cetirizine
medicines.summary: Cetirizine is an allergy tablet (an antihistamine). It eases sneezing, itching and a runny nose.
medicines.treats: Hay fever, itchy skin and hives.
medicines.looks: They are small white tablets. They come in one size: 10 mg. There is also a liquid for children.
medicines.safe: Most people can take it. It can make some people sleepy, so do not drive if it affects you. Tell your doctor if you have kidney problems.

medicines.name: Paracetamol
medicines.summary: Paracetamol is a tablet that eases pain and brings down a high temperature (fever).
medicines.treats: Headache, toothache, back pain and other mild to moderate pain.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in one size: 500 mg.
safe: Most people can take it.
Do not take more than the label says.
Some cold and flu medications also have paracetamol in them. Do not take them at the same time.
Too much can harm your liver.
If someone took too much, call 511 straight away, even if they feel well.

aliasNote.calpol: Calpol is a children's paracetamol liquid. This page is about tablets.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen
medicines.summary: Ibuprofen is a tablet that eases pain and swelling.
medicines.treats: Back pain, period pain, a sprain or arthritis.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 200 mg and 400 mg.
safe: Not always.
Do not take more than the label says.
Do not take it if you have had a stomach ulcer.
Do not take it with diclofenac, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers. You can take paracetamol with it.
Ask your doctor first if you are 65 or over, are pregnant, take a blood thinner, or have asthma or heart, kidney or blood pressure problems.

medicines.name: Diclofenac
medicines.summary: Diclofenac is a tablet that eases pain and swelling in your joints and muscles.
medicines.treats: Arthritis, back pain or a sprain.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 25 mg and 50 mg. Voltaren gel, which you rub on your skin, is a different product.
safe: Not always.
Do not take it if you have had a stomach ulcer, or have heart or kidney problems.
Do not take it with ibuprofen, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers. You can take paracetamol with it.
Ask your doctor first if you are 65 or over, are pregnant or take a blood thinner.

medicines.name: Prednisolone
medicines.summary: Prednisolone is a steroid tablet that calms inflammation (swelling, redness and pain) in your body.
medicines.treats: A bad asthma attack, arthritis, and some skin and bowel conditions. Your doctor will decide if it is right for you.
medicines.looks: They are white tablets. They come in 2 sizes: 1 mg and 5 mg.
safe: Not always.
If you have taken it for more than 3 weeks, do not stop suddenly. Ask your doctor before you stop.
It can raise your blood sugar and blood pressure.
It can make infections harder to fight.
Tell your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or an infection.
If you take it for a long time, your doctor may check your bones and eyes.

aliasNote.prednisone: Prednisone is a similar medication. Ask your pharmacist if it is the one you were given.
